comment: Strictest Windows tier (13 and under). The Store is blocked so that software arrives only
through explicitly approved Intune app assignments, SmartScreen app-install control is on,
and InPrivate browsing is blocked so that web filtering telemetry is meaningful.
2026-08-18: moved assignment from sg-tier-child to sg-devices-child because this is a corporate-owned
device restriction baseline and should target the dedicated child device group, not the user identity
tier group. Also set bluetoothBlockAdvertising to false per owner request and confirmed this baseline
does not block admin device-location capability.
name: windows-restrictions-child

payload.description: Managed by sf-intune-cac. Do not edit in the portal.
